test_vectors.coverage: Unit, booleans, identifiers, signs, leading zeros, negative zero, u64::MAX, i64::MIN, overflow at the offending digit, and malformed numbers.
Literal UTF-8, every supported escape, one-to-six hex digits, NUL, maximum Unicode scalar, and scalar boundaries adjacent to the surrogate range.
Unclosed strings and escapes, malformed Unicode escapes, excessive hex digits, surrogates, non-scalars, and unescaped controls with byte-offset assertions.
Empty and nested sequences, tuples, unit, both record delimiters, identifier and quoted keys, boolean-spelled keys, empty keys, ordering, and trailing commas.
Unit, tuple, and record payloads; separate wrapper and payload byte spans; multibyte strings; and trivia excluded from bare identifier spans.
Unicode whitespace, Unicode comments, CRLF line endings, nested block comments, comments between tokens, and EOF locations for unfinished comments.
Missing delimiters, commas and colons, mixed payloads, wrong closing delimiters, duplicate decoded keys, and content after the root.
Floats, exponents, radix and underscored integers, raw strings, byte strings, byte and character literals, and extension directives.
Exact and excessive byte ceilings, invalid UTF-8 and incomplete sequences, invalid limit settings, and size rejection preceding UTF-8 decoding.
Exact decoded UTF-8 limits, escape expansion, oversized identifiers, keys and labels, empty strings and keys, and booleans under a zero string budget.
Exact node ceilings, variant payload node accounting, per-collection item ceilings, nested collections, and zero-item empty collections.
Exact byte offsets for exhausted node, variant payload, collection, depth, and decoded string budgets.
Exact and excessive node and variant depths, independent nested-comment depth, and the default depth boundary.
256 reverse-ordered record keys retain source ordering while duplicate detection uses an ordered index.
String and byte entry points produce identical trees and preserve a diagnostic path label without opening it.
Exact and excessive file ceilings, UTF-8 errors, source labels, chunk boundaries, and zero-byte read limits.
Canonical open errors, missing required version paths, and invalid budgets before filesystem access.
Reading a directory as bytes yields ConstraintViolation with SchemaCompile source, offset zero, and static read detail.
